title: Short Shelves
notes: Side quest from the Scene Book: "The food pantry is short this week. Optional. It plants Purpose for later." The outline: [Pastor Ruth] needs one volunteer hour on Thursdays. She asks once and never preaches.
Runs the first time you visit the church while she's there, Monday through Thursday of the first week. Claude's draft.

ask.speaker: [Pastor Ruth]
text: [Pastor Ruth] is in the basement doorway with a clipboard and a pencil behind her ear. The shelves behind her have more shelf than food.
"Thursday, 5 to 6, I need one more pair of hands. One hour. Boxes and a can opener." She looks at you once, straight. "I only ask once."

choices.label: "I'll be there Thursday."
result: She writes your name down. In pencil. "See you Thursday."

effects.title: Short Shelves
effects.objective: Thursday, 5 to 6. One hour at the food pantry.

effects.title: Short Shelves
effects.objective: Thursday, 4:30 to 6:30, if you want it. She won't ask again.

choices.label: "Not this week."
result: "Okay." She means it. She goes back to counting cans.

effects.title: Short Shelves
effects.objective: You said no. She didn't ask again.
